SQLMesh State.POSTGRES_DB: Independent SQLMesh metadata and intervals database.
SQLMesh State.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated independent state database secret; preserve across redeploys.
SQLMesh State.PGDATA: Postgres data subdirectory inside the State Data volume.

SQLMesh Warehouse.POSTGRES_DB: Raw orders, physical model tables, and production views database.
SQLMesh Warehouse.POSTGRES_USER: Warehouse owner; restrict privileges for real workloads.
SQLMesh Warehouse.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated independent warehouse secret; preserve across redeploys.
SQLMesh Warehouse.PGDATA: Postgres data subdirectory inside the Warehouse Data volume.

SQLMesh Runner.PYTHONPATH: Makes the baked project configuration available to operator scripts.
SQLMesh Runner.STATE_HOST: Private DNS of the independent state PostgreSQL service.
SQLMesh Runner.STATE_DATABASE: State database from the SQLMesh State service.
SQLMesh Runner.STATE_USER: State database user from the SQLMesh State service.
SQLMesh Runner.STATE_PASSWORD: Private reference to the generated state secret.
SQLMesh Runner.STATE_SSLMODE: Prefer TLS; Railway private transport may use plaintext PostgreSQL.
SQLMesh Runner.WAREHOUSE_HOST: Private DNS of the independent warehouse PostgreSQL service.
SQLMesh Runner.WAREHOUSE_DATABASE: Warehouse database from the SQLMesh Warehouse service.
SQLMesh Runner.WAREHOUSE_USER: Warehouse user from the SQLMesh Warehouse service.
SQLMesh Runner.WAREHOUSE_PASSWORD: Private reference to the independent warehouse secret.
SQLMesh Runner.WAREHOUSE_SSLMODE: Prefer TLS; use require when targeting a TLS-enabled external database.
